In the far background, the Taipei 101 skyscraper stands tall under a bright, partly cloudy sky. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the bulldog's face, showing detailed skin textures and its concentrated expression as it holds the trumpet. The background is a soft bokeh of park greenery. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the unicycle's orange-rimmed wheel and the dog's white paws pedaling as it moves along the textured brick ground. (4) The camera pulls back to a wide shot as the bulldog rides toward the edge of a pond. It loses balance, tilting sharply to the left, and falls into the water with a massive white splash as pink particles or flower petals fly into the air.
